format: JSONL: id, messages (user instruction + standalone assistant response), provenance metadata; structures only linked through metadata
template_allocation: Five equal integer quotas per original action/subgroup (difference at most one), then deterministic group-specific shuffle; SuperCell separator preserved
bench_prompt_policy: No random paraphrasing; replace only the original cif file wording with structure, preserving operation and raw parameter strings
bench_response_policy: Fixed first action-specific response for each action; excluded from training response quotas
response_allocation: Nearest integer global 25% GENERAL quota, apportioned across actions by largest remainder; uniform four-template quotas per response pool; separate deterministic streams for response kind, response template and user template
path_convention: Resolve metadata paths as corpus_directory / metadata.path_base / metadata.input_cif (or output_cif, source_file, original_source_file). Indices are zero-based.
